title: Detecting RNA-protein proximity at DNA double-strand breaks using combined fluorescence in situ hybridization with proximity ligation assay
protocol: Insert one sterile coverslip (20 mm diameter) into each well of a 6 well plate.
Add 2 mL of 0.01% poly-L-lysine solution in PBS into each well of a 6 well plate and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.
Vacuum aspirate the poly-l-lysine solution and wash twice with 2 mL PBS.
Seed 3 × 105 U2OS-AsiSI-ER cells in 2 mL of complete DMEM.
Incubate the cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 24 hours to allow attachment on coverslips.
Vacuum aspirate the culture media after poly-l-lysine incubation.
Wash wells twice with PBS to remove residual poly-l-lysine.
Add 500 nM of 4-hydroxytamoxifen (4-OHT) in 2 mL of complete DMEM and incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 4 hours.
Wash the cells twice with 2 mL ice-cold PBS.
Incubate cells with 2 mL of PFA (4% in PBS) for 15 minutes at room temperature to fix the cells.
Wash the fixed cells three times with 2 mL ice-cold PBS.
Permeabilize cells with 0.2%–0.5% Triton X-100 for 10 minutes.
Wash the permeabilized cells three times with PBS.
Add 80 μL of FISH-PLA Blocking Buffer to a pre-warmed humidified chamber per coverslip.
Place the coverslip face down on the blocking solution and incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Add SSC, diluted DNA probes, and DEPC-H2O to an RNAse-free tube.
Incubate the mixture at 95°C for 3 min followed by immediate snap-cooling on ice.
After cooling, add Triton X-100, RNAsin plus, and ssDNA while keeping the solution on ice.
Add 60 μL of FISH-PLA probe buffer onto glass slides.
Place the slides in a humidified chamber and incubate at 95°C for 3 min followed by 12–18 h at 37°C.
Take the coverslip from the humidified chamber and place it into a new 6 well plate.
Add 2 mL of 2× SSC washing buffer to each coverslip and incubate at 20°C for 5 min with gentle rocking.
Repeat the SSC washing step twice more, gently rocking.
Wash twice with 2 mL PBS for 5 min, gently rocking.
Add 80 μL of Duolink Blocking Solution to each coverslip and incubate at 37°C for 1 h.
Dilute the primary antibody in Duolink Antibody Diluent.
Add 60 μL of the diluted primary antibody solution to each coverslip.
Incubate the coverslips with primary antibodies 12–18 h at 4°C in a humidified chamber.
Do not allow sample to dry out.
Tap the coverslip on a tissue quickly to remove excess buffer.
Add 2 mL of Wash Buffer A in each well of a 6 well plate, tap off any excess primary antibody solution from the coverslips and place them cell side up in the wash buffer.
Incubate at 20°C for 5 min with gentle rocking.
Repeat the incubation step twice.
Dilute Minus PLA probe 1:5 in Duolink Antibody Diluent.
Add 60 μL of the probe solution onto parafilm in a humidity chamber.
Tap off excess buffer from coverslips and place them cell side down onto the probe solution in the humidity chamber.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 h.
Thaw Duolink ligation buffer during minus PLA probe incubation, resuspend by pipetting to dissolve any precipitates if present.
Add 2 mL of Wash Buffer A to each well of a 6 well plate, tap off excess probe solution and place coverslips cell side up in the wash buffer.
Incubate at 20°C for 5 min with gentle rocking.
Repeat the incubation step twice.
Dilute Duolink ligase buffer at a 1:5 ratio in DEPC-H2O.
For 60 μL of ligase reaction solution, add 1.5 μL of ligase enzyme to 58.5 μL of diluted Duolink ligase buffer.
Add 60 μL of ligase buffer onto the parafilm in the humidity chamber.
Tap off excess buffer from the coverslips and place cell side down in the humidity chamber.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Thaw Duolink amplification buffer during ligation reaction incubation.
Add 2 mL of Wash Buffer A to each well of a 6-well plate.
Tap off excess ligase reaction solution and place coverslips cell side up.
Incubate at 20°C for 5 min with gentle rocking.
Repeat the wash step twice using Wash Buffer A.
Dilute Duolink amplification buffer at a 1:5 ratio in DEPC-H2O.
Protect diluted buffer from light.
For a 60 μL ligase reaction, add 0.75 μL of polymerase enzyme to 59.25 μL of the diluted Duolink ligase buffer.
Add 60 μL of amplification solution onto parafilm in humidity chamber.
Tap off excess buffer from coverslips and place cell side down in humidity chamber.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour and 40 minutes, protecting from light.
Add 2 mL of Wash Buffer B to each well of a 6-well plate.
Tap off excess probe solution and place coverslips cell side up.
Incubate at 20°C for 10 min with gentle rocking, protecting from light.
Repeat wash step twice using Wash Buffer B.
Perform final wash with 0.01× washing buffer B at 20°C for 1 minute, protecting from light.
Add 50 μL of Duolink in situ Mounting medium with DAPI to a microscope slide.
Tap off the excess washing solution and mount the coverslip on the microscope slide.
Seal the edges of the coverslip with clear nail varnish.
Wait 15 min before acquiring images at the microscope.
Image acquisition using an Olympus Confocal Microscope FV1200 with a 60× objective.
Use DAPI (405nm) and Texas Red (559nm) filters, speed settings at fast, and an area of 1024 × 1024.
Acquire images using Z stacks at a 1 μm step size.
Process confocal images saved in oib format using Fiji Image J software.
Open the image in Fiji Image J software.
Tick the box “Split channels” in the options for “Bio-formats import options”.
Select the DAPI signal window corresponding to sample_name.oib – C = 0.
Select the FISH-PLA signal window corresponding to sample_name.oib – C = 1.
Visualize split images in greyscale or arbitrary colours using ‘Image/Colour/Channels tool’ from the main menu of ImageJ.
Select Image/Stacks/Z Project from the main menu of ImageJ to stack all z stacks acquired at the microscope.
Insert values for “Start slice” and “Stop slice” in the window ‘ZProjection’.
Select Max intensity from the drop-down menu “Projection Type”.
Save the processed images as TIFF files.
Download the Speckle Counter Pipeline from cellprofiler.org/examples#speckle-counting.
Open the pipeline with CellProfiler Software using File/Import/Pipeline from File.
Analyze FISH-PLA images with the CellProfiler software.
Select the Images module in CellProfiler and upload images for analysis by dragging and dropping files into the Images tab.
Insert “C = 0” in the “Select the rule criteria”/“File/Does/Contain” section of the NameAndTypes module and assign the name “DAPI” to these images.
Choose either “Color image” or “Grayscale image” based on file type after Image J processing for DAPI images.
Repeat for foci images, setting “C = 1” in the “Select the rule criteria”/“File/Does/Contain” section and assign name “FISHPLA.”
Click “Update” at the bottom of the window to list selected files.
Set the input image value to "DAPI" in the Identify Primary Objects section.
Name the primary objects identified as “Nuclei”.
Maintain the typical diameter of objects within 30–200 pixel units.
Select the input image as “FISHPLA” for Mask Image and name the output image as “MaskedFoci”.
Set the input image value to "MaskedFoci" in the second Identify Primary Objects section.
Name the primary objects identified as “Foci” based on per-object thresholding.
Identify the “Parent Objects” as Nuclei and the “Child Objects” as Foci in the Relate Objects module.
Select “Start Test Mode” located in the menu bar at the bottom of the CellProfiler window.
Pause and play icons will appear next to the different analysis modules.
Select “Step” to visualize the outputs from each of the analysis modules.
In the section “Export to Spreadsheet”, select the output folder.
Plot the Children Foci Count values present in the excel file “Nuclei” using GraphPad Prism software.
Optimize input analysis settings for accurate identification of nuclei and foci manually as needed.
Optimize additional settings such as threshold strategy, thresholding method, method to distinguish clumped objects, and method to draw dividing lines between clumped objects.
Use Test Mode to evaluate the results of chosen settings.
